name: Ironclad
description_en:
Ironclad is a cloud contract lifecycle management platform spanning creation, review, signature, storage, analysis and fulfilment. Its no-code Workflow Designer coordinates routing and approvals, while current AI features use contract, negotiation and workflow context to answer questions or initiate work.

Ironclad sells CLM, AI-assistant and eSignature solutions with configurable implementation and integration scope. A company buying one solution should not assume it has purchased every agent, connector or deployment instance shown on the platform site.
description_zh:
Ironclad 是云端合同生命周期管理平台，覆盖创建、审阅、签署、存储、分析及履约。无代码 Workflow Designer 协调路由与审批，当前 AI 功能结合合同、谈判和流程背景回答问题或发起工作。

Ironclad 销售 CLM、AI 助手及电子签署方案，并配置实施和集成范围。购买其中一种方案，不能假定获得平台网站列出的全部 Agent、连接器或部署实例。

sections.title_en: Create a controlled NDA request process
sections.title_zh: 创建受控 NDA 申请流程
sections.en: For a repeatable NDA, an organisation could define intake questions, approved language, an exception approval and signature routing in Workflow Designer. Test a routine request and a counterparty redline that should require legal review. Conditional automation is documented, but the team must provide the actual approval policy and template. A completed workflow should be checked against its signed output and stored metadata, not just a green status.
sections.zh: 对重复使用的 NDA，组织可在 Workflow Designer 中定义申请问题、批准条款、例外审批和签署路由。可测试普通申请，以及应交法务审查的对方修订。文档证明支持条件自动化，但实际审批政策和模板须由团队提供。流程完成后应核对签署文件及存储元数据，不能只看成功状态。

sections.title_en: Distinguish AI answers from authorised actions
sections.title_zh: 区分 AI 回答与已授权操作
sections.en: The current platform describes Ironclad Agent as an entry point for questions, workflows and specialised intake, archive, review and renewal agents. Recommendations use deal history and counterparty context. When evaluating it, specify which records it may read and which actions need approval. A convincing answer about a prior negotiation should be traced back to the actual agreement; the site’s performance figures were not independently measured.
sections.zh: 当前平台把 Ironclad Agent 描述为问题、流程以及申请、归档、审阅和续约专用 Agent 的入口，建议会使用交易历史和签约方背景。评估时应明确可读取记录及需要审批的动作。关于历史谈判的回答应追溯到实际协议；本文未独立测量网站性能数字。

sections.title_en: Price products, partners and extras separately
sections.title_zh: 分别核对产品、实施伙伴和附加项
sections.en: The official pricing page provides a custom quotation shaped by products, users, workflows and growth. It distinguishes choosing CLM/AI/eSignature, running implementation internally or through legal engineers/partners, and extras such as APIs, integrations or additional instances. Its FAQ says some integrations are included and others cost extra. No numeric public payable amount was verified. Ask for these items on the order form rather than treating a platform demonstration as a bundled quote.
sections.zh: 官方按产品、用户、流程及增长需求定制报价，并区分 CLM／AI／签署选择、内部或法务工程师／伙伴实施，以及 API、集成和额外实例等附加项。FAQ 说明部分集成包含、部分另收费。未核实公开应付金额，应在订单列明这些范围，不能把平台演示当作捆绑报价。

sections.title_en: Cloud infrastructure does not settle every operating commitment
sections.title_zh: 云基础设施不等于全部运营承诺
sections.en: The pricing FAQ describes cloud deployment, encryption and US-hosted Google Cloud production infrastructure across multiple zones. These statements are a dated vendor description, not a buyer-specific residency or recovery contract. Confirm the current deployment option, export procedure, retention and recovery targets for the purchased solution. A self-hosted edition or open-source licence was not verified.
sections.zh: 定价 FAQ 描述云部署、加密，以及美国 Google Cloud 多可用区生产基础设施。这些是特定读取时点的厂商说明，不是买方专属驻留或恢复合同。应确认所购方案的当前部署选项、导出步骤、保留及恢复目标。本文未核实自托管版或开源许可。

sections.title_zh: 按持续维护的合同项目评估
sections.en: Cross-functional legal and business teams with recurring agreement types have a clear use case. Occasional signature-only work may not justify workflow administration. Start with an owner, representative agreements and a documented exception path, then compare how changed fields affect approvals and integrations. No signing, API execution, AI-accuracy or recovery test was conducted; implementation speed remains unmeasured.
sections.zh: 跨法务与业务团队、反复处理同类合同的组织，有明确使用场景。仅偶尔签署可能无需承担流程管理。可先确定负责人、代表性协议及例外路径，再检查字段修改如何影响审批和集成。本文未实际签署、执行 API、测试 AI 准确率或恢复，也未测上线速度。
